host.label: IP address
host.help: Local IP address of the Snapmaker (port 8080)

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: How often to request status (minimum 2 seconds)

apiToken.label: API token (optional)
apiToken.help: Copy server.token (UUID) from Luban machine.json. Windows: %APPDATA%\snapmaker-luban\machine.json — Linux: ~/.config/snapmaker-luban/machine.json — macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/snapmaker-luban/machine.json. Leave empty to request a new token (confirm on the touchscreen).
